entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah, agent ID 303. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Sarah, I need to return this VeloBand GPS Tracker immediately. I've been trying to get this sorted and your online portal is useless. This is absolutely unacceptable service!

I understand you're frustrated, sir, and I'm here to help you get this resolved. To start, could you help me understand the reason for the return? What specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's not a preference! I haven't even opened the box! I had a major family emergency. My husband was rushed to the hospital for emergency surgery right before his military deployment was supposed to start. I've been dealing with that, not playing with some new gadget. Now I'm told I'm outside the return window? This is unbelievable! Get me a manager.

I'm so sorry to hear about your husband; that sounds incredibly stressful. I truly hope he's recovering well. Please, let me look into this for you personally. I'm confident I can sort this out without needing to escalate the call. Can I get your order number or the email address on the account?
Fine. The email is m.henderson@email.com. But if you give me any more trouble, I'm writing a review that will make your head spin. Just fix this.

Thank you, I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 22nd. I understand your concern about the timeline, especially given the emergency with the hospital and his deployment. Let me check our official return policy for you.

Alright, I'm looking at our internal knowledge base right now. It clearly states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery, as long as they are in original condition. Since you received it 24 days ago, you are well within that timeframe.
Oh. So you're saying I can return it? No problem?

Yes, absolutely. I sincerely apologize for any confusion the website may have caused. Given the circumstances you've been through, I am more than happy to process this for you right now. I've just initiated the return. You will receive a pre-paid shipping label to your email within the next 10 minutes. Just put the unopened box into a mailer, attach the label, and drop it at any post office.
Okay... good. That's what I expected. So I'll get a full refund?

Yes, a full refund to your original payment method. Once our warehouse receives the item, which usually takes about a week, the refund will be processed and should appear in your account in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's it. Thank you for taking care of it, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Again, I wish your husband a speedy recovery. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a better day.
